title: Car accident in Poland (DTP / Kolizja)
question: What to do after a car accident in Poland?
short_answer: Stop immediately, turn on hazard lights. Call 112 if anyone is injured. For minor collisions with no injuries, use the European Accident Report form instead of calling police.
conditions: Turn on hazard lights and place warning triangle (required by law)
Kolizja (no injuries): both drivers can settle without police using Europejski Formularz Wypadkowy
Wypadek (injuries or death): call 112 immediately — mandatory
Exchange: name, surname, insurer name, OC policy number, registration plate
Take photos of both vehicles and the scene before moving cars
All drivers must have valid OC (third-party liability) insurance
Do not move vehicles until situation is documented (for serious accidents)
exceptions: If the other driver refuses to cooperate or is drunk — always call police (112 or 997)
If only your car is damaged and no other party involved — no need to call police
EU citizens: European Accident Report is valid across all EU countries
penalties: Fleeing the scene of an accident: up to 5 years in prison
Driving without OC insurance: fine 4,000–6,000 PLN depending on vehicle type
Failure to provide assistance to injured: up to 3 years in prison
